$comment: Bare launch profile for the Raw Claude tab (plan Design 1-5, 7, 8) and, through `rendered`, the Falcon-hosted Rendered Bare tab (P5). Read by src-tauri/src/bare/ at every bare spawn and by Falcon (src-falcon/src/claude.rs bare_spawn) and the sidecar at every hosted one. Placeholders: {{root}} = the Vidar install root, {{home}} = this install's agent home (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Vidar\homes\<install-root-key>, src-tauri/src/bare/home_path.rs), {{payload}} = this folder's `payload` file, or for a row naming rune sets the payload built from `setsPayload` into {{home}}\layer\payload-<hash12>.md (src-tauri/src/bare/layer.rs), all absolute at spawn; the {{plugins}} arg expands to `--plugin-dir {{root}}\plugins\<name>` per entry of `plugins` (the declared set, never vidar.json pluginDirs). `assets` is what tools/sandbox/check-zip.ps1 requires in the release zip.

rendered.$comment: The Falcon-hosted Rendered Bare tab (plan P5). Falcon builds the env from the allowlist plus `overlay` above plus this `overlay`; the sidecar (tools/claude-sidecar-bare.mjs) loads exactly these `plugins` from {{root}}\plugins\<name> (never vidar.json pluginDirs). The gate mod is Rendered only: the Raw line above never carries it. CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS keeps the gate's hooks module on in a cold config dir.
